messages.content: 誰是目前排名第一的網球選手？

function.name: sports_team_standing
function.description: Retrieve the current standing/ranking of a sports team in its respective league. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

team_name.description: The name of the sports team.

league.description: The league in which the team participates.

season_year.description: The season year for which the standing is needed. If not provided, current year is assumed. Default: 1994

message.content:
**Answer (as of the latest publicly‑available ATP/WTA rankings)**  

| Category | Current #1 (April 2024) | Notes |
|----------|------------------------|-------|
| **Men’s singles (ATP)** | **Novak Djokovic** (Serbia) | Djokovic reclaimed the top spot after winning the 2024 Australian Open and has maintained it through the first half of 2024. |
| **Women’s singles (WTA)** | **Iga Świątek** (Poland) | Świątek has been world No. 1 since early 2023 and remains at the top of the rankings as of April 2024. |

> **Important:**  
> • Tennis rankings are updated every Monday.  
> • The information above reflects the most recent rankings that were publicly available up to **April 2024**.  
> • If you need the exact ranking for a specific week (e.g., the current week in 2026), you would need to consult the official ATP/WTA websites or a live sports data feed.

If you’re looking for a different category (e.g., doubles, junior rankings, or a specific season), let me know and I can adjust the answer accordingly.
